title: Cross-Pulse: Engineering Leads Weekly — 2026-07-22
summary: Rapid sync between engineering leads to align on a) three priority operational risks (autoscaling regressions, quantization rollout flakiness, and region failover testing), b) short staffing hotspots and proposed reallocation for two weeks, and c) an experiment plan to reduce p99 tail latency on hosted API by 10%. Meeting focused on concrete owners and timeboxed experiments.
agenda: Opening: 3 quick wins and 2 escalation items
Staffing and capacity rebalancing for Q3 delivery
Performance experiment kickoff: p99 tail latency reduction
Rollout status: quantized model variants and fallback policies
notes: Opening: agreed on 'sprint-lite' posture for next two weeks to prioritize stabilization work over new feature launches.

Incidents: Autoscaling regression on 07/19 caused 12% increased 95th percentile latency for non-streaming requests between 03:00-05:00 UTC. Root cause tracked to a threshold miscalibration in the burst policy. Marcus to own hotfix and test plan.

Quantization rollout: Omar reported ~8% failure rate on Canary 2 (edge cases in KV cache invalidation). Immediate rollback of Canary 2; Canary 1 remains stable. Action to add deterministic cache tests to CI before next canary.

Region failover testing: Jin noted that annual DR test scheduled for Aug needs a dry-run next week to ensure Playbook steps align with new VPC private control-plane changes. Talia to coordinate runbook updates.

Staffing: Two engineers from serving-runtime are queued for product demo support next week. Leads agreed to borrow one infra engineer (Jin will reassign) and pull a solutions-eng contractor (Devon) to help triage the demo impact. Hiring update: 2 offers extended for SRE fill; anticipated start early Aug.

Performance experiment: Elena proposed a focused 10-day experiment (A/B) to reduce p99 tail: combination of micro-batching for medium-length requests, prefix KV caching for repeat customers, and targeted fast-path kernels for 8k context. Sofia and Marcus to scope metric dashboard and guardrails. Success metric: 10% reduction in p99 with <=2% cost increase.

Rollout policy: agreed to add an automatic fallback variant mapping when quantized model returns >3% reject rate for a 30-minute window. Feature flag gating will be added to the console for customer tier opt-in.
Observability ask: Elena requested retention increase for token-level traces for 48 hours during the experiment window; finance confirmed temporary spike budget available if scoped properly.
AOB: Marcus reminded teams to update the 'model-compatibility' matrix in the repo before Jul 30 to avoid mismatches during dedicated capacity upgrades.
decisions: Pause Canary 2 for quantized rollout until CI deterministic cache tests added
Timebox p99 experiment to 10 days starting 2026-07-27; target -10% p99
Reassign one infra engineer to serving-runtime for demo week; onboard solutions-eng contractor for triage
Implement auto-fallback mapping for quantized variants with 30-minute reject threshold

Omar Ruiz: add deterministic KV cache invalidation tests to CI and rerun Canary by 2026-07-29

Jin Park: schedule DR dry-run and update failover playbook by 2026-07-28

Priya Singh: update cross-team prioritization board and notify product leads about sprint-lite posture by 2026-07-23
blockers: CI flakiness causing non-deterministic cache test failures
Limited observability retention quotas under current plan (needs temporary uplift)
Two serving-runtime engineers booked for customer demo next week leaving a 30% coverage gap
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Experiment could temporarily increase infra cost >5% - Mitigation: set cost kill-switch in dashboard to auto-revert experiment if cost delta exceeds threshold
Risk: Rollback of Canary may mask latent bugs - Mitigation: add synthetic load tests covering KV corner-cases and increase sampling for token traces
Risk: DR dry-run exposes unexpected network ACL drift - Mitigation: perform a staged path validation with subset of regions before full failover
next_meeting: 2026-07-29 — focus: experiment mid-point check, incident follow-ups, hiring pipeline update
